findings.proposedIrEvidence: rules[0].action=INCUR_DEBT; capacityExpression.kind=UNLIMITED_CAPACITY with gatedBy=null; conditions[0] and conditions[1] address only the Section 7.1 financial-covenant compliance proviso; no condition, qualifier, exception or dependsOn reference mentions Liens or Section 7.3(g).
findings.sourceEvidence: Indebtedness secured by Liens permitted by Section 7.3(g); provided that the Parent Borrower shall be in compliance, on a pro forma basis after giving effect to the incurrence of such Indebtedness, with the financial covenants contained in Section 7.1 recomputed as at the last day of the most recently ended fiscal quarter of the Parent Borrower and its Subsidiaries for which financial statements are available as if such Indebtedness had been incurred on the first day of each relevant period for testing such compliance
findings.verifierReasoning: The real §7.2(c) basket is limited to Indebtedness secured by Liens permitted by Section 7.3(g). The proposed IR would allow any Indebtedness whenever the Section 7.1 pro forma compliance condition is satisfied. A hypothetical unsecured borrowing that satisfies Section 7.1 would be outside the real §7.2(c) basket but would appear to be permitted by the proposed IR. This changes the scope of the permission and is material.

findings.verifierReasoning: The only machine-readable operand of the compliance condition is an unparseable placeholder. The human-readable description cannot be executed by downstream tools, so the IR does not faithfully encode the central proviso that conditions the entire permission. This is material because the §7.2(c) permission is available only if the proviso is satisfied.

findings.proposedIrEvidence: condition[1].expression.kind=AS_OF with asOfDate='(unspecified)'; value.kind=METRIC_REFERENCE, value.type=MONEY, metricName='financial covenants in Section 7.1, pro forma recomputed'.
findings.sourceEvidence: recomputed as at the last day of the most recently ended fiscal quarter of the Parent Borrower and its Subsidiaries for which financial statements are available as if such Indebtedness had been incurred on the first day of each relevant period for testing such compliance
findings.verifierReasoning: The source fixes the measurement date as the last day of the most recently ended fiscal quarter for which financial statements are available, with the incurrence treated as if it had occurred on the first day of each relevant period. The IR leaves the date unspecified, so compliance could be computed as of a different date and produce a different result. The IR also types the Section 7.1 financial-covenant metric as MONEY, which the source does not support; financial covenants are not expressed as a dollar amount in this clause. Both defects are material to any downstream computation of the gating condition.
